paragraphs: Partake sells a sharing platform built around an app that lets people borrow and lend household goods within a local area. The company describes the product as a turnkey solution that gives members access to what their community already owns. Onboarding is described as creating a profile for free and finding a local hub, with searching, requesting and returning items as the steps that follow.

The homepage sets out four paths: citizen, cities and municipalities, business and organization, and building a platform of your own. For cities and municipalities, the offer is a fully supported, turnkey sharing solution aimed at letting citizens share, save and connect. A parallel offer for business and organizations covers employees and members on the same supported, turnkey basis.

A separate platform offer lets an organization deploy a sharing ecosystem tailored to its industry, with the infrastructure, safety framework and expertise supplied by the company. The stated mission is to make sharing the obvious choice so that every community can unlock its collective abundance. The frequently asked questions page lists question headings, including what happens if an item is damaged or broken.

quote.text: The app for sharing everyday items.
